scope: opt-in beta passport profile only; production and the default beta profile remain unchanged

enabled.credential_rules: non-placeholder, at least 32 characters, equal in both holders, distinct from DSC operator and internal API credentials, absent from other rendered settings and mounted secrets

disabled: no CSCA issuance flag or credential is selected by the beta passport profile when omitted
preflight: read and validate the dedicated credential only when EnablePassportNative is selected; fail before any image or service mutation without exposing its value
